chunks: He created you from a single cell, then from it created its mate; and provided eight varieties of cattle for you. He formed you in the mother's womb, formation after formation in three (veils of) darkness. He is God your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god other than He. How then can you turn away?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the creation of humans and livestock in Surah Az-Zumar?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Az-Zumar underscores God's omnipotence by tracing creation from a single soul to the intricate embryonic development within 'three veils of darkness,' a detail often elaborated in Shia tafsir as referring to the uterine wall, membranes, and placenta. It juxtaposes human origin with the provision of eight types of livestock, affirming Allah as the sole Sovereign and challenging humanity's tendency to turn away from this evident truth.
